title: YouTube Music gets more conversational with new AI features | TechCrunch
summary: YouTube is adding new AI-powered features to YouTube Music that aim to make it easier for listeners to discover music, explore artists, and find podcasts they may otherwise miss. Both updates are coming soon to YouTube Music and YouTube Premium subscribers worldwide.
